profile.headline: Mechanical/Software Engineer
profile.summary: Innovative engineer with extensive experience in commercial New Product Development (NPD), government contracting, and technical program management. Self-starter with a highly versatile skill set encompassing mechanical, electrical and software design. Cross functional team leader. Systems engineer for connectivity products producing $40M+ in yearly revenue.

company.name: Blue Storm Associates, Inc. dba PEMDAS Technologies & Innovations

positions.title: Technical Lead/Systems Engineer, Connectivity Systems
positions.description:
Lead global software, hardware, and mechanical teams in development and sustainment of complete Connectivity Systems portfolio of products. Develop and maintain imbedded firmware for vehicle communications using multiple communications protocols (CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C, UART)
Developed GNSS data processing and filtering algorithms for performance evaluation/improvement.
Regularly update senior leadership and project stakeholders on project timing, cost, and quality.
Perform site-readiness evaluation for production facilities (Mexico). 
Responsible for complete product design including prototype hardware design, software development, and vehicle integration/testing.
Member of Technical Leadership Team responsible for technical evaluation and approval of all product designs.
Volunteer on Engineering Plant Safety Team.

positions.title: Lead Mechanical Engineer
positions.description: Project Team Lead over Software, Hardware, and Mechanical development projects. Specification development and project schedule/cost management. Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Hydraulic Disc Brake systems

positions.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
positions.description: Powertrain and structural component design and integration. Inventor for electro-mechanical park brake for low speed vehicles (lsv's).

positions.title: Mechanical Engineer
positions.description:
Development of fixture design for validation of electric brake for spacecraft.
Lead development and on-aircraft testing of C-5 rudder limiter fixture (Dover AFB, DE).
Design draft and assemble load application assembly for F-15 Main Landing Gear (MLG), Nose Landing Gear (NLG) calibration fixture.
Develop adjustable safety cage system for F-15 landing gear calibration fixture.
Oversee and assist with C-5 MLG test fixture installation (Hill AFB, UT).
Write, test, and verify Matlab code for processing and analyzing flight test data.
Produce complete 3D CAD assemblies, to original manufacturer print, for multiple military aircraft landing gear (F-15, F-16, C-130).
Model preparation/defeaturing for Finite Element Analysis (FEA) in ANSYS.
Solidworks and Matlab mentoring and troubleshooting for other Engineers.

positions.title: Framer
positions.description: Construction of new homes as well as additions and renovations to existing homes
